skill.name: alacritty-terminal
skill.description: Terminal emulation library from Alacritty for VT100/xterm compatible terminal embedding

generated_query: I'm building a GPUI-based code editor and want to add a terminal panel that displays output from a shell process. I have a PTY that sends ANSI escape sequences, and I need a terminal emulation library that can parse those, manage a scrollback buffer, and let me render the text with colors and attributes. I also need to support text selection with the mouse. Can you show me how to set up the terminal with an event listener for things like title changes, how to feed the PTY output into it, and how to access the grid cells for rendering? I'm especially interested in how to create a selection object and update it on mouse drags, and how to scroll the viewport.
